newsitem.title: USA: Fla. St Lucie 2 nuclear unit at 76 pct and rising.
newsitem.headline: Fla. St Lucie 2 nuclear unit at 76 pct and rising.

text.p: Florida Power and Light Co's St Lucie 2 nuclear unit is producing at 76 percent of its rated 839 megawatt capacity and increasing output, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Tuesday.
The unit was returning to service as scheduled following a refueling outage that began April 13.
The adjacent unit, St Lucie 1, was operating at full power, the NRC said in its daily plant status report. It is also rated at 839 MW.
The St Lucie power station is in Hutchinson Island, Fla.
